exposure: discussion with husband about family planning
outcome: women's decision-making on family planning method use (alone or jointly with partner)
cohort: The study participants were married women in Ethiopia who were currently using or had recently used a family planning method, based on PMA 2020 national survey data.
finding: Approximately half of married women (51.2%) independently decide on their family planning use, with this rate significantly increasing from 32.8% in 2014 to 51.2% in 2020.
